summary: If a job skips the Default Execution Environment, check template, project and organization overrides, GLOBAL_JOB_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENTS order and the main_executionenvironment table; setting Global default execution environment in Settings forces it.
questions: Why isn't my job using the Default Execution Environment?
How do I force the default execution environment for all jobs?

answer_card.title: Job not using the Default Execution Environment
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Check for an execution environment set on the template, project or organization.
2. Check `GLOBAL_JOB_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENTS` (not set by default) and its order in `/etc/tower/conf.d/execution_environments.py`.
3. Check database order:
```bash
echo "select id, name, created from main_executionenvironment where organization_id is null and managed = False order by created desc;" | awx-manage dbshell
```
Fix: set **Settings > Automation Execution > System > Global default execution environment** to *Default Execution Environment*.
